name: Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art
funding: Run by Scottsdale Arts under a City of Scottsdale contract; 2024-25 sponsors incl. Nationwide, SRP, Piper Trust, Warhol Fdn.
watch: 2025 censorship row: transfeminisms show cut and retitled. The 2024-25 list had SRP and the Salt River Pima-Maricopa community.
records_note: Has annual report, audited statement and Form 990 sections, names its FY2025/26 trustees and lists partners by tier; report years could not be read.

name: SECCA
funding: State museum division since 2023 (NC Dept of Natural & Cultural Resources); private donors incl. Hanes family, Z. Smith Reynolds Foundation.
watch: Z. Smith Reynolds Foundation is R.J. Reynolds tobacco-fortune money; no current tobacco stake verified. List covers downtown space and programs only.
records_note: No records of its own; parent NC Museum of Art posts impact reports 2021 to 2025, lists trustees and files 990s; no donor list.

name: Seoul Museum of Art
funding: Seoul Metropolitan Government museum; Hana Financial Group co-funds SeMA-Hana Art Award; patrons' association SeMA人[in] since 2014.
watch: June 2025 censorship row: a critic's martial-law essay was cut from a catalogue. Patrons' board includes SK Group and MBK Partners.
records_note: Its patrons' page names the SeMA人[in] directors, including Hana Financial and MBK Partners executives, undated; it posts no reports, accounts or board.

name: Serlachius Museums
funding: Gösta Serlachius Fine Arts Foundation, endowed from a paper and forestry fortune.
records_note: The foundation page names its seven board members, but no annual report, accounts or donor list is posted on the museum site.

name: Serpentine Galleries
funding: £9.8M annual budget. Arts Council England National Portfolio Organization (NPO), Bloomberg Philanthropies public pavilion commissions, individual patron circle. Always free admission.
records_note: It files group accounts at Companies House for 2020 to 2025 and lists 14 trustees, but posts no annual reports and no named supporters.

name: Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art
funding: €14.8M annual budget, 950k park and gallery visitors. Fundação de Serralves endowment, Portuguese Ministry of Culture, and Porto Municipality.

name: Setouchi Triennale
funding: Executive committee led by Kagawa Prefecture and the Fukutake Foundation. Sponsors (Feb 2025): Japan Tobacco, Cosmo Oil, Okayama Gas, Shikoku Electric Power, Chari-Loto, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Mitsui & Co.
watch: Chari-Loto sells online keirin race bets. Okayama Gas is a gas utility and Cosmo Oil a refiner. Japan Tobacco is a tobacco maker.
records_note: The festival lists over 200 sponsors and donors as of February 2025 and names its executive committee, but posts no reports or accounts.

name: Shedhalle (Rote Fabrik)
funding: City of Zurich Culture Department, Canton of Zurich, Pro Helvetia; autonomous cultural association.

name: Shepparton Art Museum
funding: Greater Shepparton City Council gave A$2.57M of A$3.18M revenue (2024-25), with Creative Victoria. Donors include the Fairley Foundation, Carrillo Gantner, the Zurcas family and Bega Cheese.
watch: Opened 2021. SAM Ltd, a non-profit, took over from the council, which leases it the building for A$1 a year.
records_note: Posts annual reports from 2018-19 with audited accounts, a named 2024-25 donor roll and its directors.

name: Singapore Art Museum (SAM)
funding: State, under Singapore's Visual Arts Cluster, plus corporate partners.

name: Singapore Art Museum
funding: FY23/24: state (Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth) plus Mapletree, Singapore Tourism Board, CHARLES & KEITH Foundation, New Carlsberg Foundation (alcohol).
watch: Board member Pierre Lorinet is a director of oil trader Trafigura (joined 1 Jul 2024). Roster is from FY23/24.
records_note: Its About page posts audited annual reports for FY2015 to FY2025, a named board, and the FY2025 report lists donors and sponsors.

name: Site Gallery
funding: £565k income (FY2025). Arts Council England £320k, Sheffield City Council, Esmée Fairbairn, JG Graves, Jerwood, University of Sheffield, Fidelity UK Foundation; Foyle, Garfield Weston and Wolfson capital grants.
records_note: No annual reports found; accounts are on the Charity Commission register, the Supporters page names funders and donors undated, and board members are listed.
